Biology 101 — Unit 2 Laboratory Sheet

This sheet accompanies the Unit 2 practical. Work through the figure overleaf before the session. You will be asked to identify each labelled structure and to state, in your own words, the single function printed beside it. Bring your annotated copy to the laboratory.

Assessment for this unit is by identification only. You are not required to reproduce the drawing, and no marks are given for artistic accuracy. Specimen VR-118 was prepared in the departmental glasshouse and fixed on the fourteenth of the month.

Marks are divided evenly across the labelled structures overleaf. Where a function is printed under a label, that function is the expected answer; where no function is printed, only the name is required.
